result:
**Verdict: FAIL.** The only cause is one new finding of mine, **F-DG3-180** (Medium, not mandatory). All 32 DG3 acceptance texts still pass when tested literally.

The candidate checked out: `sha256:58ef3f47…` (754 files, source `f49ca160`). It recomputed the same at the start, in the disposable clone, and against the current HEAD at the end.

**What I ran** (logs in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-2/`):
- **Static:** typecheck, build, lint, openapi:lint (270 operations), no-cdn, format and contrast all exit 0. The new formula lint rules pass on the shipped code.
- **Formula guard (T-DG3-KBE-D):** I tried 9 forbidden forms (Function alias, Reflect, `.constructor`, createRequire, child_process and so on) in a throwaway file; all 9 were refused. The formula acceptance results are the same as in round 1.
- **Unit:** Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8: 1565/1565 in all four runs.
- **Integration, twice:** 793/793 each time. All 27 migrations applied, 270 operations live, every p3-pending list empty, and the 2 new inheritedApproval tests pass. Round 1 had 791 tests; the 2 extra are those.
- **e2e:** 13 specs in chromium-en and chromium-ar, under both locale settings, on the real stack.
  - Each setting: 204 passed, 2 failed, 0 skipped, 0 flaky.
  - The product and A20 specs are 172/172 per setting, the same set and count as round 1.
  - My own spec's 163 recorded checks per project all pass.
  - The 2 failures are my new layout probe, F180, one per project. Those failures are the finding below.
- **Accessibility:** axe found 0 issues in the product specs and 0 serious or critical issues in mine.
- **Validators:** `--register DG3`, `--pipeline`, `--historical DG2` and `--historical DG1` all PASS.

**Inherited-approval annotation (T-DG3-ARCH-05):**
- **API: correct.** Every state (none, pending verification, accepted, accepted but not counting, rejected, revoked) and the rule for which record is shown both work. The gate stays draft and no gate decision is written. The auditor sees the same annotation read-only and gets 403 on every write.
- **Screen:** the badge text, neutral styling, link and Arabic/English rendering are correct, and axe finds nothing.
- **Layout: broken.** The badge overflows its gate card and field: 7 of 7 badges in English, 4 of 7 in Arabic. In some cards this hides the "(does not approve this gate)" clause. That is the finding.

**Finding:**
- **F-DG3-180, Medium, owner frontend-ux-engineer.** The badge's chip style has `white-space: nowrap` (`apps/web/src/styles/app.css:803`), so the long badge text runs out of its card on a 1280 px screen. It goes under the next card, past the edge of the screen (x=1449), or over the Approver column in the gate view. Axe doesn't catch overlap, so the axe checks stay clean.

**Disclosures:**
- **Why FAIL and not PASS:** the gate validator rejects a PASS record that contains a failing check, and my layout check genuinely fails.
- **Possible duplicate:** at the very end, after F-DG3-180 was already measured and run, the HEAD commit subjects showed that the domain reviewer raised F-DG3-170 for an "inherited-approval badge overflow". I didn't open their record, so I can't confirm the two are the same; they may be duplicates.
- **Other exits:** my four trial runs while writing the spec and the deliberately failing lint probe are explained in `RUN-NOTES.md`.

**Spec changes:** my round-2 spec is a copy of the round-1 spec, with three renames and three new tests. IA1 covers the annotation through the API, U3 checks it on screen, and F180 is the layout probe.

**Residuals (not blocked):** live registry, live CI and Keycloak were checked on the offline surface only, as the assignment allows.

The disposable clone and scratch files are deleted.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG3/round-2/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`
